source.text: Timothy Pakron, Garden Variety (via Rancho Gordo)

items: 1 lb beans (2 cups dry), soaked and rinsed
4 cups water (brothy; stay under the ½ fill line)
⅓ cup olive oil (also tames foam)

sub: 2 to 3 shallots or 1 large onion, chopped
Pinch of dried herbs (thyme, oregano) or spices (cumin, paprika)

steps.action: Once depressurized, remove kombu and bay, stir in:

items: Fresh herbs (dill, parsley, basil, chives, thyme)

steps.text: Store in jars, submerged in broth, up to 1 week. Or drain and toss with arugula, lemon, and olive oil.
